answers.b: Splitting a model's layers across multiple GPUs in a pipeline

explanations.b: Correct. Pipeline parallelism assigns different model layers to different GPUs.
explanations.d: Incorrect. Data parallelism copies the model.

answers.b: A subdivision of the input batch that flows through the pipeline

explanations.b: Correct. Micro-batches are smaller pieces of the total batch processed sequentially through the pipeline.

questions.question: Q3 What is a pipeline bubble?

answers.b: Idle time where GPUs wait for data in the pipeline

explanations.b: Correct. Bubble periods are when GPUs are idle because data hasn't reached them yet.

questions.question: Q4 How does increasing the number of micro-batches affect the pipeline?

explanations.a: Incorrect. More micro-batches reduce idle time.
explanations.b: Correct. More micro-batches keep GPUs busier, reducing the relative bubble overhead.

questions.question: Q5 What does PP stand for in pipeline parallelism?

explanations.b: Correct. PP is the number of pipeline stages (GPUs in the pipeline).

questions.question: Q6 How does pipeline parallelism reduce per-device memory?

answers.b: By storing only a fraction of the model's layers on each GPU

explanations.b: Correct. Each GPU stores approximately 1/PP of the total model.

answers.a: The time shown on a wall clock — total elapsed real time

explanations.a: Correct. Wall-clock time is the total real-world time from start to finish.
explanations.b: Incorrect. CPU time is only part of wall-clock time.

questions.question: Q8 What happens if PP is set too high relative to M?

answers.b: The pipeline bubble grows, wasting GPU time

explanations.a: Incorrect. Too many stages with too few micro-batches creates large bubbles.
explanations.b: Correct. F_bubble = (PP-1)/(M+PP-1) increases as PP grows relative to M.
explanations.c: Incorrect. Memory per device decreases with more stages.
explanations.d: Incorrect. Pipeline configuration doesn't affect model accuracy.

questions.question: Q9 Which earlier experiment's concepts affect T_layer_group?

explanations.a: Correct. Compute time relates to thermal behavior, and transfer time relates to interconnect bandwidth.

questions.question: Q10 What is the formula for pipeline bubble fraction?

explanations.c: Correct. The bubble fraction depends on the ratio of pipeline stages to total slots.
